name: @noeos/verifactu-workspace
description: Reproducible workspace for the Noeos VERI*FACTU component and CLI.
author: Noeos contributors

scripts.ci: npm run toolchain:check -- --profile node-24-primary && npm run policy:check && npm run governance:check && npm run docs:check && npm run regulatory:check && npm run regulatory:snapshots && npm run contracts:generate && npm run contracts:check && npm run build && npm run api:check && npm run generated:check && npm run vectors:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run license:check && npm run pack:check && npm run consumer:check && npm run reproducibility:check && npm run sbom
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/check-contracts.mjs && node scripts/check-contract-traceability.mjs && node scripts/check-rule-catalog.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node .build/tests/tests/index.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-branches=95 --test-coverage-functions=98 --test-coverage-lines=98 --test-coverage-include='packages/verifactu/dist/esm/index.js' .build/tests/tests/index.test.js
